title: A long cloud session picks up hook changes from main, not only the copy it installed at start
why: A stale guard copy lets mistakes through that main's guard refuses.
note: Coordinator 13:00 CST Nov 11: a long cloud session runs the hooks it installed at start. The coordinator ran a guard copy older than 10e38b0ae (lane start: effort field and brief as prompt) until 12:50 CST today, so 7 lane starts sent a bare "/effort medium" prompt and the lane-effort-pin guard never saw them (retrospective brief audit, 12:56 CST). The guard that would have stopped it is lane-effort-pin, which was not loaded. Owner 12:59 CST (relayed by the retrospective): "its weird a lane can be spawned without its brief first preprovided like somesthings going wrong if the lane/session just autospawns and then gets filled in after the fact, feels weird". Plan 691a84e places this as stage 3 item 3.10. Owner 13:21 CST Nov 11 (relayed by the retrospective, plan 3.10 at 707853e): "yes sorry i meant reinstall not restart i agree". When hooks or settings on main changed since the install, a session reinstalls at its next turn, in place; it restarts only for a change a reinstall cannot load (a lane measures that first). Coordinator 13:57 CST Nov 11: the session-start installer reuses /root/claude-settings-main (ddaa393c0, 17:50 CST Nov 9) because it thinks that clone has local commits main lacks, so a resume reinstalls the stale copy. The stale lane-effort-pin refused the 3.0 lane start at 13:59 CST; the coordinator reinstalled from main 6745ade70 with merge/install_from_main.sh (exit 0) under the owner's 13:21 ruling. Triage 14:08 CST Nov 11: install_from_main.sh installs the local branch main with no check against origin/main. This clone's main sat 5727 commits behind (da8d8073c, Nov 2), so the first run at 14:08 installed that old copy, exit 0. After the main fast-forward, the second run at 14:10 installed 6745ade70. Guard owed: the script refuses, or fast-forwards, when local main is behind origin/main and has no local commits.
